# Cover letter writer: personalized job application letters

Curated by Skill Harbor — the Claude Office Skills contributors' cover-letter playbook: a structured method (opening hook, value proposition, why-this-company, strong close) with four ready templates — standard professional, with referral, career change, entry-level/new graduate — plus writing tips (quantify every achievement: "grew sales 45% YoY, adding $2M in revenue" not "increased sales"), show-company-research prompts (recent news, values, products, culture), eight common mistakes to avoid (repeating the resume, too generic, salary talk too early), a fully worked example (Senior Software Engineer at Stripe), and customization options (tone, length, focus, industry). Works best with the job posting text and the user's experience pasted in. Honest caveats: it cannot fetch job postings itself — paste the text; letters must be proofread for dates and details; it cannot guarantee interview callbacks; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
